name: DisplayDrivers
description: One display API over Arduino_GFX, LovyanGFX, TFT_eSPI, M5GFX, EPD Painter and GxEPD2, plus a headless no-op backend. Pick one with a build flag and the same tft_display / tft_sprite calls drive an LCD, an OLED, an AMOLED, an RGB/DSI panel, an e-paper — or nothing at all, on boards with no display.
